statement: Global uniqueness in smooth isotropic elasticity. Proves that full static boundary displacement-to-traction data determine both smooth real Lamé moduli on every bounded connected smooth domain in ℝ3, provided μ > 0 and $`3\lambda+2\mu\gt 0`$ on the closure. Neither analyticity, proximity to constant coefficients nor prior knowledge near the boundary is required.
